FINISHED PRODUCTION 1-bit pixel game illustration in the visual language of WORLD OF HORROR: crisp horror-manga / Macintosh pixel ink, strong readable contours, basic structural linework, selective short hatch strokes, clean object silhouettes, uncanny quiet domestic atmosphere. Preserve the slight wide-angle perspective. Design at 432x318 native pixels, exact 72:53 landscape ratio, readable when reduced to that size, bottom 38 logical pixels stay black. No UI, no border, no text, no added characters or props. Finished elegant drawing, not a placeholder diagram. Keep the same objects but simplify their interior detail radically. The door handle is the main interactive focal point: a clear lever silhouette with a clean backplate, no speckled texture.
